appBaseUrl.title: appBaseUrl
appBaseUrl.description: appBaseUrl is the full public URL of the Papra instance (required).

firstUserAsAdmin.title: firstUserAsAdmin
firstUserAsAdmin.description: firstUserAsAdmin promotes the first registered user to admin.

ipAddressHeaders.title: ipAddressHeaders
ipAddressHeaders.description: ipAddressHeaders lists headers used to determine the client IP (for reverse proxy setups).

isRegistrationEnabled.title: isRegistrationEnabled
isRegistrationEnabled.description: isRegistrationEnabled controls whether new users can self-register.

endpoint.title: endpoint
endpoint.description: endpoint is the S3-compatible endpoint URL. Leave empty to use the default AWS endpoint.

forcePathStyle.title: forcePathStyle
forcePathStyle.description: forcePathStyle enables path-style S3 addressing (required for MinIO and most self-hosted S3).

s3.title: s3
s3.description: s3 settings are only used when driver=s3.

tag.title: tag
tag.description: rootless variant runs as a non-root user; matches podSecurityContext/securityContext below.

volumeName.title: volumeName
volumeName.description:
volumeName explicitly binds the PVC to a specific PV by name.
Leave empty for dynamic provisioning.
Automatically set to the chart-managed PV when volume.nfs.server is configured.

claim.title: claim
claim.description: claim configures the PVC created by this chart. Ignored when existingClaimName is set.

existingClaimName.title: existingClaimName
existingClaimName.description:
existingClaimName uses a pre-existing PVC instead of creating one.
When set, claim and volume below are ignored entirely.

mountPath.title: mountPath
mountPath.description: mountPath is the path inside the Papra container where the share is mounted.

usePolling.title: usePolling
usePolling.description:
usePolling enables polling-based file watching instead of inotify.
Must be true for NFS, SMB, and other network filesystems.

server.title: server
server.description: server is the NFS server hostname or IP. Leave empty to skip PV creation.

volume.title: volume
volume.description:
volume creates a static PersistentVolume bound to the chart's PVC.
Useful for NFS or other manually-provisioned shares.
Set volume.nfs.server to enable PV creation; leave empty to skip.

ingestionFolder.title: ingestionFolder
ingestionFolder.description:
ingestionFolder configures Papra's built-in ingestion folder feature.
Papra watches <mountPath>/<org-id>/ for files to automatically ingest.
Find your org ID in the Papra UI under Settings -> Organization.

nameOverride.title: nameOverride
nameOverride.description: This is to override the chart name.

clientSecrets.title: clientSecrets
clientSecrets.description: clientSecrets is used when create=true. Map of providerId -> clientSecret.

create.title: create
create.description:
create controls whether the chart creates the OIDC Secret.
Defaults to false — provide a pre-existing Secret via secretName instead,
or set create=true and supply values below only for local/dev use.

secretName.title: secretName
secretName.description:
secretName overrides the generated Secret name when set.
Defaults to <fullname>-oidc when empty.

existingClaimName.title: existingClaimName
existingClaimName.description:
existingClaimName uses a pre-existing PVC instead of creating one (e.g. one bound to a
manually-provisioned PV). When set, storageClassName and size below are ignored.

size.title: size
size.description: size is the PVC capacity. Ignored when existingClaimName is set.

storageClassName.title: storageClassName
storageClassName.description: storageClassName is the Kubernetes storage class to use. Empty string uses the cluster default.

persistence.title: persistence
persistence.description: persistence configures the PVC that backs /app/app-data (SQLite DB + local document storage).

replicaCount.title: replicaCount
replicaCount.description:
Papra stores its database in a single SQLite file on the app-data PVC, so this must stay
at 1. Scaling beyond 1 replica risks corrupting the database from concurrent writers.

create.title: create
create.description:
create controls whether the chart creates the S3 Secret.
Defaults to false — provide a pre-existing Secret via secretName instead,
or set create=true and supply values below only for local/dev use.

secretName.title: secretName
secretName.description:
secretName overrides the generated Secret name when set.
Defaults to <fullname>-s3 when empty.

s3Secret.title: s3Secret
s3Secret.description: s3Secret configures the S3 credentials (only used when config.storage.driver=s3).

authSecret.title: authSecret
authSecret.description: authSecret is used when create=true. Must be at least 32 characters.

create.title: create
create.description:
create controls whether the chart creates the Secret.
Defaults to false — provide a pre-existing Secret via secretName instead (e.g. an
ExternalSecret), or set create=true and supply values below only for local/dev use.

databaseEncryptionKey.title: databaseEncryptionKey
databaseEncryptionKey.description: databaseEncryptionKey is used when create=true and encryptionKeyEnabled is true.

secretName.title: secretName
secretName.description:
secretName overrides the generated Secret name when set.
When create=false, this must name the pre-existing Secret to use.
Defaults to the chart fullname when empty.

secret.title: secret
secret.description: secret configures the AUTH_SECRET (and optional DATABASE_ENCRYPTION_KEY) credentials.

securityContext.title: securityContext
securityContext.description: readOnlyRootFilesystem is false because papra writes to /app/app-data at runtime.

port.title: port
port.description: port is the HTTP port papra listens on and the Service exposes.

annotations.title: annotations
annotations.description: Annotations to add to the service account

automount.title: automount
automount.description: Automatically mount a ServiceAccount's API credentials?

create.title: create
create.description: Specifies whether a service account should be created

name.title: name
name.description:
The name of the service account to use.
If not set and create is true, a name is generated using the fullname template
